hero.description: I build Discord bots, backend systems and long-running Linux services. I like things that feel clean, fast and maintainable instead of flashy.

about.title: I prefer building things that actually feel like me.
about.lead: Instead of generic portfolio language, I like describing my work in a simpler way.
about.body: I'm 20. I've been active around Discord since 2016, and building bots and systems since 2021. My most comfortable workspace is still coffee + terminal.

projects.title: What's currently on my desk.
projects.lead: No big claims here — just the things I am actually working on. Open a card for the details.

flask.description: A general-purpose Discord bot under LabCafe. It brings moderation, community tools and useful features together in a cleaner structure.
features: Minimal but capable command and panel direction
Community and management features under one roof
flask.longDescription: Flask is intended to be a long-living general-purpose Discord bot instead of a one-off experiment. The goal is to keep it simple on the surface while giving it a solid architecture underneath.

yhmod.description: A dedicated moderation bot for Yazılım Hub, focused on security, logs, panels and a cleaner management flow.
features: Cleaner log flow and optimized management UIs
Stable Linux deployment for real usage
yhmod.longDescription: YHMod is the custom moderation bot I am shaping for Yazılım Hub. The aim is to keep the system practical and strong without turning it into a cluttered control panel.

ticket.description: A separate ticket system for Yazılım Hub. It uses private threads and a panel-first support flow.
features: Panel-focused usage with fewer slash commands
Separate review path for moderation appeals
Cleaner support, transcript and staff workflow
ticket.longDescription: The ticket bot is being built to feel lighter than the usual crowded ticket systems. Reducing visible commands and moving actions into panels is a big part of the design.

lab.description: A workspace for small experiments, helper tools and ideas that sometimes grow into main projects.
features: Bot, web and small automation work
Ideas that may evolve into larger projects
Comfortable testing area before real deployment
lab.longDescription: Not everything needs to be a full product. Sometimes a small script, a tiny web tool or a rough idea deserves its own place before it turns into something bigger.
